title: Rational certificates for the exact quantum query complexity of nine open cases of EXACT_{k,l}^n (Ambainis-Iraids-Nagaj conjecture)
description:
Exact rational Barnum-Saks-Szegedy SDP certificates showing that the exact quantum query complexity of EXACT_{k,l}^n (f(x)=1 iff |x| in {k,l}) equals max{n-k,l}-1 for n=7 {1,5}; n=8 {1,5},{1,6},{2,6}; n=9 {2,6},{2,7},{1,5},{1,6},{1,7}. With the lower bound of Ambainis, Iraids and Nagaj (2017) this settles these cases of their Conjecture 1 (l-k>=2), which were open after Yao and Ye (2023).

Includes two independently written standalone checkers (exact arithmetic), a tamper test, the generating code, an explicit 5-query algorithm for n=7, SDP numerics for all open l-k>=4 instances with n<=10, and a 3-page note.

Not peer reviewed. Produced with substantial help from an AI assistant (Claude, Anthropic); every claim is backed by a certificate that can be checked independently.
